text: Development ➡️ Production. We've been building Archimedes for scale from day one. As we iterate through stages of engine development testing, we have set up our Engine Development Center in Long Beach to be capable of building and shipping one Archimedes engine every 8 days. Once final development testing is completed we will down-select our final qualification configuration of hardware and will begin delivering engines every 8 days to the stand for flight ATP testing.

Archimedes, lit. 🔥 Our reusable methane/LOX engine for Neutron comes to life for another recent hot fire. 650+ tests, power levels above 100%, and confidence built across various mixture ratios and inlet pressures for what we expect for flight.
